rule_name: Relative clause with जो, not a Telugu-style participle
explanation_shown_to_learner: Telugu puts the clause before the noun (నేను చదివిన పుస్తకం); Hindi usually uses जो (वह किताब जो मैंने पढ़ी) or पढ़ी हुई
